resources.name: be
resources.runtime_note: Three consecutive 86-byte raw records in one type-5 resource file. resources.runtime_note: A 13-word raw type-8 table. Values 28 through 35 match the eight original MIDI resource IDs already represented in the browser audio controller; this is a strong correspondence, but the exact original caller/field semantics remain unconfirmed.

cross_reference.note: Do not confuse resource-index type 8 with RLEF scene-object type 8. They are separate type systems.
